jobs.title: Director, Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
At Viral Nation,
we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

The Director, Business Intelligence will lead enterprise-wide analytics strategy and will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of analysts delivering actionable insights across sales forecasting, retail performance, campaign measurement, and influencer/paid/social strategy optimization.

This leader will serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales, Marketing, Brand, eCommerce, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating data into commercial growth opportunities, driving ROI, and embedding analytics into core business decision-making. The role combines strategic vision, technical depth, cross-functional leadership, and team development.

Responsibilities:

Act as a senior analytics partner to client account, strategy, and service teams by translating client objectives into scalable, best-in-class measurement frameworks that support social-first marketing performance.
Serve as the senior analytics advisor to executive leadership, shaping marketing, retail, and social investment decisions through data-driven insights.
Elevate analytics from reporting to strategic advantage by synthesizing data into clear narratives that inform brand positioning, channel strategy, and enterprise decision-making.
Own end-to-end measurement strategy across paid media, influencer, social, and retail media, ensuring clear linkage between investment and revenue outcomes.
Forecast and quantify incremental revenue and retail lift across eCommerce and offline retail partners by developing predictive models that connect media spend, influencer engagement, and social performance to sales velocity and conversion.
Design and operationalize robust ROI frameworks, including brand lift studies, sales lift studies, incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, and marketing mix modeling, translating insights into optimized channel mix and budget allocation.
Build scalable measurement systems to evaluate influencer effectiveness, content performance, audience growth, and conversion impact, informing creative strategy and platform optimization.
Identify emerging consumer and digital engagement trends to inform brand strategy, innovation, and go-to-market planning.
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing analytics team, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, commercial acumen, and executive-ready storytelling.
Design and oversee scalable data collection and reporting infrastructure, including structured databases, automated reporting workflows, dashboards, and standardized presentations.

Qualifications:

Extensive experience in marketing, media, or agency environments, with demonstrated ability to apply analytics and research to drive client strategy and business outcomes.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Social Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in research, analytics, and measurement, with a proven track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives.
Advanced expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies, including brand tracking, brand and communications strategy, brand lift studies, regression analysis, Market Mix Modeling, social listening, and digital and site analytics.
Deep technical proficiency in analytics and BI technologies, including Python and SQL for analysis and data modeling, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and Snowflake for data infrastructure, and BI tools such as Sigma or comparable platforms for scalable reporting and dashboarding.
Demonstrated ability to architect and optimize analytics workflows, data pipelines, and reporting systems that support automation, scalability, and self-serve insights.
Strong executive-level communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior client stakeholders, providing strategic guidance grounded in data, research rigor, and business context.

This role has an annual salary range of $140,000 - $160,000.

This range reflects the full scope and progression of the role, from building capability to operating with sustained impact at a higher level. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits and total rewards package designed to support our team as they grow with us.

Where an offer falls within this range is determined through the interview process. Candidates are benchmarked by the hiring team based on role scope, relevant experience, skill alignment, and expected impact, using consistent and objective criteria.

Compensation Philosophy:

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

AI in Recruitment:

Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

jobs.description:
Description

VP Development and Alumni
is currently seeking a Full-time Limited Term Data Scientist - Applied AI
for approximately 24 months with a strong possibly of extension, based on organizational needs and mutual fit. This position is currently hybrid with three days per week in the office.

The Office of Development and Alumni (D&A) exists for the mutual benefit of the University of Calgary and its stakeholders, and coordinates donations of gifts to the University, as well as communication and engagement with UCalgary Alumni and the broader community. The Data Scientist - Applied AI is a Data Science professional reporting to the Manager, Data Systems, and provides expertise and strategic support to measurably improve and expand D&A's approach to fundraising and outreach. Specifically, the position studies internal and external data, and employs data mining, machine learning, applied artificial intelligence, predictive modelling, forecasting, and statistical analysis techniques to help identify, classify, understand, and cultivate connection, engagement, and philanthropic contributions.

The Data Scientist - Applied AI must accommodate the needs of numerous faculties and central and support units (e.g., Annual and Leadership Giving, Alumni Engagement). They must coordinate analytics activities with Prospect Research & Pipeline staff who specialize in prospect and portfolio management.

There is a high volume of work requiring sound judgment, diplomacy, tact, project management, decision-making, and the ability to manage fluid expectations, projects, and deadlines.

This position is suited to a data science professional who can apply academic knowledge and practical experience to real-world problems, including emerging applied AI opportunities.

The maximum salary for this position is $85,910.00 annual.

Summary of Key Responsibilities
(job functions include but are not limited to):

Fundraising Analytics Program Leadership (20%)

Work with the Manager, Data Systems to set a vision for advanced analytics and applied AI within D&A, and develop and implement a comprehensive program that provides data-driven intelligence to aid University-wide and faculty/unit fundraising, communications, and engagement.
Work with D&A teams across campus to identify specific issues for review and analysis, and develop/create solutions. Generate new knowledge and previously unknown insights from D&A and external data.
Grow analytics capacity and standards within the organization through training, workshops, and supporting skill development.
Mentor and coach Reporting Analysts in analytics and data science best practices, and contribute to enhancing the team's knowledge and abilities.

Modeling, Statistical Analysis, and Fundraising Strategies (70%)

Provide strategic leadership and employ project management best practices on all fundraising, communications, and engagement analytics projects. Establish and communicate vision for projects, including alignment to organizational vision and strategy.
Design, prototype, implement, and evaluate generative AI solutions, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, and agentic workflow. Evaluate internally developed, vendor-provided, and hybrid approaches based on business value, cost, technical fit, maintainability, privacy, security, and integration requirements.
Employ machine learning and applied AI techniques and build predictive, behavioral, and AI-assisted solutions that are used to increase revenue, deliver time savings, and improve ROI throughout the department. Develop strategies to ensure that what is built actually makes a difference.
Act as the senior expert on data science. Identify, prioritize, and execute applied analytics that deliver insights across goals including, but not limited to: contact acquisition, donation conversions, increasing value of average donations, engagement with the University, and segmenting Constituents.
Develop product offerings including visual intelligence tools and applications for enhancing business performance. Determine the best way to deliver data science initiatives into the hands of end users.
Gather, filter and segment large and unstructured data sets for the purposes of identifying, classifying and refining constituent pools. Identify overall trends and patterns in giving, interests, volunteerism, event participation, etc. and search for explanations and underlying causes.
Leverage available data sources and identify new sources of data. Mine, retrieve, query, and append data from internal databases, and external data sources such as electronic screening services, census records, social media as appropriate, surveys, focus groups, demographic studies, marketing data, etc.
Work closely with the rest of Advancement Data team to coordinate and participate in the preparation and presentation of reports, visualizations, interfaces, and analysis, capturing progress and trends, and including appropriate recommendations or conclusions.
Manage and monitor data science model import processes into D&A's Constituent Relationship Management database (Blackbaud CRM), and support reliable incremental extraction and API-based integration patterns where required.
Partner with business users throughout solution design, implementation, and continuous improvement to integrate AI into practical workflows, encourage adoption, and measure usage, user feedback, and realised business value.

Knowledge Building and Management (5%)

Stay abreast of current and emerging trends in data science, business intelligence, philanthropy, and higher education, and communicate to department and senior leadership as appropriate.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications / Requirements:

Graduate degree required, with demonstrated competencies in data science, predictive modeling, fundraising analysis, machine learning, applied AI, research, and/or similar fields.
Demonstrated analytical, project design/management, and creative problem-solving skills required.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex and large datasets from various sources, extract actionable insights, and communicate these to business users, both orally and through data visualization tools such as Tableau/Power BI, and/or Reporting Services. Must be able to impart understanding of complicated ideas and statistics in a clear and simple manner to a wide variety of stakeholders, from frontline staff to Executive Leadership.
Proven ability to build, implement, and optimize predictive data models required.
Experience building or supporting AI-powered solutions using large language models (LLMs), retrieval augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and AI agents or agentic workflows is preferred.
Direct experience using advanced statistical tools, big data technologies, machine learning/AI, and data mining. Highly proficient programming skills with scripting languages (e.g., Python). Highly proficient programming skills with scripting languages (e.g., Python), including data processing, automation, and API integration.
Expertise in analytical applications, program development, and evaluation methodologies. Experience evaluating analytical and AI solutions.
Intermediate to advanced knowledge of data management, database design and querying using Transact-SQL language required.
Professional experience with SQL Server and its components (SSIS, SSRS), IIS (Microsoft Internet Information Services), and Visual Studio required.
Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, GitHub Copilot, Claude code, OpenAI, or comparable cloud data and AI platforms is a preferred asset.
Highly developed interpersonal, written, and oral communications skills.
Experience mentoring and training others to increase their own knowledge and abilities in data science, and a willingness to share skills and techniques with peers and colleagues.
High degree of professionalism, ethical sensitivity, and discretion; ability to maintain a commitment to confidentiality.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities and meet challenging and changing deadlines.

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Information Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

POSITION PURPOSE SUMMARY

The Chief Technology and Information Officer (CTIO) provides enterprise leadership and strategic direction for technology, information systems, data, cybersecurity and digital capabilities across The Salvation Army Canada and Bermuda Territory.

As a senior organizational leader, the CTIO ensures technology strategy and investment support The Salvation Army’s mission, strategic priorities and operational needs. The role is accountable for technology, cybersecurity and resilience, enterprise systems, data and digital capability, technology operations, vendor partnerships, financial stewardship and the ongoing development of a high-performing technology function.

Working across a large, geographically dispersed and decentralized organization, the CTIO builds trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders, balances enterprise consistency with operational realities, and drives technology adoption and organizational efficiencies in a way that reflects The Salvation Army’s mission, values and culture.

ACCOUNTABILITIES

Mission, Culture and Organizational Leadership

Authentically lead in alignment with The Salvation Army’s mission, vision, values, Christian identity and spiritual foundations, recognizing that its social and community services are expressions of its higher purpose to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in communities.
Ensure technology strategy, investment and decision-making ultimately enable people, ministry and services to advance the mission.
Contribute as an enterprise leader to organizational strategy, priorities and decisions beyond the technology portfolio.
Balance enterprise standards and priorities with legitimate operational, geographic and ministry-specific needs.

Executive and People Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing technology leadership team with clear accountability, a service-oriented culture, strong succession and workforce planning, and the appropriate balance of internal and external capability.
Provide strategic advice to senior leadership, translating complex technology, cybersecurity, data and digital issues into clear organizational choices, risks, opportunities and investment decisions.
Lead significant organizational change associated with technology transformation, recognizing that successful adoption depends on people, process, culture and technology.
Build strong relationships with operational leaders and users to understand needs and continuously improve technology effectiveness.
Model strong stewardship, integrity and accountability in leadership and decision-making.

Enterprise Technology Strategy

Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities and mission.
Stabilize and simplify the technology environment, strengthening reliability, integration, interoperability and sustainable adoption.
Optimize existing technology platforms and investments before introducing new solutions.
Improve connectivity and interoperability between systems to create a more seamless technology and user environment.
Establish technology roadmaps, portfolio governance and prioritization that sequence investments appropriately and balance innovation, affordability, risk, organizational readiness and capacity.
Lead targeted modernization and transformation where it creates clear organizational value, while assessing emerging technologies thoughtfully.
Oversee the technology project and investment portfolio, ensuring appropriate governance, stakeholder engagement and benefits realization.

Cybersecurity, Data and Technology Risk

Provide executive oversight of cybersecurity, information security, privacy, technology risk and resilience.
Ensure appropriate controls, governance and compliance are in place to protect organizational information, systems and technology assets.
Maintain effective disaster recovery, business continuity and technology resilience capabilities.
Ensure security, privacy, data protection and risk considerations are embedded in technology investments, vendor relationships and emerging technology adoption.

Technology Operations and Service Delivery

Ensure reliable, secure, responsive and cost-effective delivery of enterprise applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services, end-user technology and service management.
Establish service standards, performance measures and continuous improvement practices that strengthen user experience and technology effectiveness.
Maintain an enterprise technology architecture that supports integration, scalability, security and future organizational requirements.

Financial, Vendor and Investment Stewardship – Money, Sourcing and Commercial Discipline

Lead technology operating and capital budgets and multi-year investment planning, ensuring investments demonstrate strategic value, affordability and sustainability.
Oversee business cases, cost-benefit analysis and benefits realization for significant technology investments.
Establish effective sourcing strategies and lead strategic vendor relationships, contract performance and commercial negotiations.
Drive cost effectiveness through technology simplification, optimization, disciplined sourcing and effective management of technology assets and services.

Strategic Business Enablement, Data and Artificial Intelligence

Connect technology, data and digital priorities directly to organizational strategy, mission outcomes, service delivery and measurable value.
Act as an enterprise integrator across ministries, functions and geographies, using technology and data to simplify processes, strengthen service delivery and improve decision-making.
Lead enterprise data strategy, governance, stewardship, quality, analytics and reporting to enable trusted and actionable information.
Establish and oversee responsible AI and automation governance, ensuring use cases are mission-aligned, secure, ethical, legally compliant, operationally practical and supported by appropriate human oversight.
Establish governance and performance measures that allow senior leaders to monitor technology value, data maturity, digital adoption and AI readiness.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

Mission and Organizational Alignment

Demonstrated alignment with and ability to authentically lead within The Salvation Army’s mission, values and Christian foundations.
Demonstrated understanding that The Salvation Army’s social and community services are expressions of a broader mission to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in communities.
Ability to operate effectively within a large, complex, values-based and decentralized organization.
Demonstrated commitment to ethical leadership, stewardship, collaboration and service.

Education and Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering or a related discipline is required.
Master’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, Information Systems or a related field may be considered an asset.
Relevant executive technology, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, governance or program management certifications may be an asset.
An equivalent combination of education and significant relevant executive experience may be considered.

Experience and Knowledge

Significant progressive leadership experience in technology, information systems, digital or related discipline, including substantial senior executive or enterprise leadership experience.
Demonstrated success developing and executing enterprise technology strategies and leading transformation or modernization.
Experience leading technology within a large, complex, multi-site and/or geographically dispersed organization.
Broad executive-level understanding of enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, integration, digital capability and technology operations.
Demonstrated experience overseeing cybersecurity, technology risk, resilience and business continuity.
Experience with enterprise data governance, analytics and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.
Significant experience managing technology budgets, investment decisions, strategic vendors and major contracts.
Proven success in building and developing high-performing leadership teams.
Demonstrated experience leading complex organizational change and influencing senior stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience advising executive leadership and governance bodies on technology strategy, investment, cybersecurity, risk and organizational implications.
Experience in a decentralized, faith-based, not-for-profit, healthcare, public sector or similarly complex service organization is considered an asset.
Demonstrated experience establishing or maturing enterprise data strategies, data governance, analytics capability and information management practices across a complex organization.
Experience reviewing, governing and deploying artificial intelligence or advanced automation capabilities with appropriate attention to ethics, privacy, cybersecurity, risk, adoption, benefits realization and operational readiness.

SKILLS AND LEADERSHIP CAPABILITIES

Strategic enterprise thinker who connects technology, data and digital priorities to organizational strategy and mission outcomes.
Strong executive judgment with the ability to prioritize competing demands and balance innovation, risk, cost, organizational capacity and readiness.
Proven people leader who builds organizational capability, develops senior leaders and creates clarity and accountability.
Exceptional relationship builder and influencer who can navigate a decentralized, relationship-driven organization while advancing enterprise priorities.
Clear and compelling communicator who translates complex technology issues into understandable organizational implications and decisions for technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven people leader who builds organizational capability, develops senior leaders and creates clarity and accountability.
Strong business, financial and commercial acumen, including technology investment, vendor management and benefits realization.
Data-driven and digitally fluent executive who can establish trusted information, enable analytics and guide responsible AI and automation adoption with appropriate governance and human oversight.
Values-based leader who demonstrates integrity, humility, stewardship and a strong service orientation.
Comfortable with complexity and ambiguity, with the ability to bring clarity, structure and direction to challenging organizational situations.

Compensation:

The target hiring range for this position is $244,046.40 to $305,052.80 with a maximum of $366,059.20. Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

Blackpoint Cyber is the leading provider of world-class cybersecurity threat hunting, detection and remediation technology. Founded by former National Security Agency (NSA) cyber operations experts who applied their learnings to bring national security-grade technology solutions to commercial customers around the world, Blackpoint Cyber is in hyper-growth mode, fueled by a recent $190m series C round.

Company Culture

At Blackpoint Cyber, we value high-quality execution, ownership, and strong morals. Our principles are never tested, and we are proud to always do right by our customers. We are an energetic and collaborative team that maintains a high-performance culture and enables growth by overcoming challenges in the modern cyber threat landscape. If you are a driven professional with a passion for learning and contributing at a high level, Blackpoint Cyber welcomes you.

Position Overview

Blackpoint Cyber is seeking a strategic and visionary Director of Platform Engineering to lead the development and execution of its Unified Security Posture data platform, which powers the company’s data-centric cybersecurity solutions. This leader will serve as the single-threaded owner for the roadmap and operations of the cloud-based platform, including vendor integrations, developer and data tooling, identity, authentication, tenant management, and other core services.

This role will drive vision and execution across multiple engineering teams, working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, product leaders, and site reliability engineering partners. The Director of Platform Engineering will translate business and technical needs into clear strategies, oversee roadmap execution and service quality, and build a high-performing organization through strong hiring, mentorship, and technical leadership. As a highly visible leader, this person will also help establish company-wide operational excellence practices for instrumentation, incident response, root cause analysis, and remediation.

Key Responsibilities

Define and drive the platform roadmap aligned with product and business goals.
Partner across the Product organization and SRE team to ensure platform security, reliability, and scalability.
Lead the development of the data pipeline, integrating with Blackpoint’s endpoint agent and vendor data, including storage, tiered access, and query capabilities.
Deliver platform services and public APIs supporting core functions such as tenant management, identity, and role-based access control.
Lead platform tooling and APIs that accelerate AI/ML and business intelligence initiatives.
Oversee developer productivity tooling, including CI/CD systems.
Define the long-term vision for the data platform by implementing best practices in data architecture, modeling, and governance, while staying current on emerging technologies and trends.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and partners.
Foster excellence in platform reliability, scalability, security, and software quality.
Hire, develop, and grow a high-caliber team of platform and data engineers, scaling the team and organizational structure as needed.
Drive the adoption of AI across the development lifecycle (AI DLC) to increase engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and enable teams to build and deliver high-quality products more efficiently

Qualifications

15+ years of experience in software development, preferably in cybersecurity, including at least 5 years of people management experience leading multiple teams.
Proven experience leading a Platform Engineering function at the Director level.
5+ years of experience working with large-scale AWS cloud solutions and technologies such as Postgres, Elastic, Redis, streaming data platforms, and ETL processes.
Hands-on experience architecting and building complex data platforms and service integrations.
Deep knowledge of CI/CD, production deployment at scale, and data pipeline orchestration.
Demonstrated ability to drive high-impact initiatives and long-term strategic goals.
Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why Join Blackpoint Cyber

If you are passionate about cybersecurity and have a proven track record of leading and managing software engineering teams, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Blackpoint Cyber offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a dynamic work environment where you can make a real impact in the field of cybersecurity.

Blackpoint Cyber welcomes and encourages applications from qualified individuals of all races, colors, religions, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment.

For eligible employees in the US, Blackpoint offers competitive Health, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance plans, a robust 401k plan, Discretionary Time Off, and other minor perks. jobs.title: Director of Business Technology
jobs.description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Keep Things Running

Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

Own the Platforms

Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

Govern and Teach

Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

Team and Partners

Lead two on-site IT staff.
Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

Strong candidates will bring:

Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:
An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

WHAT WE OFFER

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

TO APPLY

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior technical leader specializing in building high-performance, interactive data visualization platforms and enterprise reporting engines. This is an expert-level role focused on creating advanced, web-based analytical applications that combine rich, interactive frontends with highly optimized, data-intensive backends and distributed query engines. A mandatory and critical secondary focus of this role is the design and creation of custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. You will build the bridge between LLMs/AI agents and our enterprise data layers, including Starburst, enabling AI to autonomously and securely query, analyze, and report on massive datasets.

Core Responsibilities

You will own the end-to-end design and delivery of sophisticated FinTech tools used directly by investment bankers, front-office traders, and financial analysts. This requires translating complex financial workflows into intuitive, high-fidelity web interfaces. Your primary focus will be on architecting and building highly interactive, web-based analytical dashboards using Angular and React, allowing users to slice, dice, and explore massive datasets in real-time.

A key function is leveraging Starburst (Trino) to query massive, distributed datasets with sub-second latency. You will design and implement robust backend microservices (Java/Spring Boot) optimized for low-latency data retrieval, heavy aggregation, and streaming large datasets to the frontend. Furthermore, you will be responsible for designing and optimizing scalable ETL processes to manage huge volumes of financial data.

A mandatory responsibility is to design, build, and maintain custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools. This enables AI agents and LLMs to securely interface with internal databases, APIs, and reporting engines. You will also architect enterprise-grade document generation engines using the Aspose suite to programmatically create high-fidelity financial reports from complex templates.

As a hands-on player/coach, you will deliver complex data visualizations and reporting engines while mentoring junior engineers. This includes critically reviewing and taking ownership of all AI-generated code (Java, Angular, React, SQL) to ensure structural integrity, security compliance, and production readiness, while applying a deep functional understanding of Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB) to all projects.

Key Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience:

new_jobs.title: Director of Business Technology
new_jobs.description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Keep Things Running

Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

Own the Platforms

Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

Govern and Teach

Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

Team and Partners

Lead two on-site IT staff.
Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

Strong candidates will bring:

Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:
An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

WHAT WE OFFER

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

TO APPLY

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.

You will own the end-to-end design and delivery of sophisticated FinTech tools used directly by investment bankers, front-office traders, and financial analysts. This requires translating complex financial workflows into intuitive, high-fidelity web interfaces. Your primary focus will be on architecting and building highly interactive, web-based analytical dashboards using Angular and React, allowing users to slice, dice, and explore massive datasets in real-time.

A key function is leveraging Starburst (Trino) to query massive, distributed datasets with sub-second latency. You will design and implement robust backend microservices (Java/Spring Boot) optimized for low-latency data retrieval, heavy aggregation, and streaming large datasets to the frontend. Furthermore, you will be responsible for designing and optimizing scalable ETL processes to manage huge volumes of financial data.

A mandatory responsibility is to design, build, and maintain custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools. This enables AI agents and LLMs to securely interface with internal databases, APIs, and reporting engines. You will also architect enterprise-grade document generation engines using the Aspose suite to programmatically create high-fidelity financial reports from complex templates.

As a hands-on player/coach, you will deliver complex data visualizations and reporting engines while mentoring junior engineers. This includes critically reviewing and taking ownership of all AI-generated code (Java, Angular, React, SQL) to ensure structural integrity, security compliance, and production readiness, while applying a deep functional understanding of Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB) to all projects.

Key Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience:

Systems Fundamentals: Strong foundation in systems analysis, design patterns, data analysis, and the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including unit testing and CI/CD practices.
Backend Development: Extensive hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, low-latency microservices and reactive data streaming APIs.
Frontend & Visualization: Strong, hands-on experience with Angular 19+, React, TypeScript, HTML5, and Web Sockets for building interactive, data-intensive dashboards.
Data Federation & Querying: Hands-on experience with Starburst (Trino) for querying massive, distributed datasets across federated enterprise data sources.
Databases & Data Modeling: Deep experience with relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB), including physical/logical database design, data modeling, and performance tuning.
ETL & Data Processing: Proven experience designing high-throughput ETL pipelines and optimizing data flows for real-time reporting.
Enterprise Reporting: Experience building document generation engines using the Aspose suite (Aspose.Words, Aspose.Cells, Aspose.PDF).
MCP Tool Creation: Demonstrated ability to design and build custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to securely connect LLMs and AI agents to enterprise data.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on proficiency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and the ability to write structured prompts and engineer high-quality context (schemas, API specs) for AI agents.
Collaboration Tools: Strong experience with GitHub for source control and Jira for project management.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

8+ years of relevant experience
Experience designing and implementing agentic AI workflows and integrating AI agents directly into CI/CD pipelines.
A strong understanding of event-driven systems and real-time message streaming platforms like Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Domain

Functional understanding of Banking — able to articulate why their work matters, not just how it is built.

What Sets This Role Apart

This is not a conventional engineering role. You are expected to operate as a force multiplier — directing AI agents across multiple workstreams, validating output for production safety, and coaching others to do the same. The measure of success is not lines of code written, but outcomes delivered, quality maintained, and the team's collective capability raised.

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. Design, build, and deploy AI and machine learning models — including Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions — to solve complex reconciliation and data engineering challenges at enterprise scale.
